name: nonApi_portalKennelAccess
description: The one permission check for hcportal_ SPs that act on a kennel or on the platform (2026-10-13). Portal sign-in proves only identity and the portal API passes calls straight through, so this is the only gate. Allowed when ANY holds: @callerType <> 0 (Harrier Central service accounts); the caller's HC.PlatformAdmin row grants @platformCap; the caller's HasherKennelMap row for @kennelId has SuperAdmin 0x40000000 or any @flagMask bit in AppAccessFlags; or HC6.CheckKennelPermission grants @functionKey. Read-only; not API-callable (nonApi_).

parameters.name: callerType
parameters.description: ValidatePortalAuth caller type; 0 = person, anything else = service account (allowed). Default 0.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel acted on; NULL for platform-only checks (then only callerType and platformCap apply).

parameters.name: flagMask
parameters.description: AppAccessFlags bits that grant the action, OR-ed with SuperAdmin 0x40000000.

parameters.name: functionKey
parameters.description: Permissions V2 function that grants the action, via HC6.CheckKennelPermission.

parameters.name: platformCap
parameters.description: HC.PlatformAdmin right that grants the action: CanViewMonitor, CanManageNewsflash, CanEditKennel or CanManagePermissions.

codeSmells.detail: @hasherId and @allowed (OUTPUT) have no default. Only called from SQL, never from a client, so the unlogged-500 risk does not apply.
A small read-only gate called inside each caller's TRY; a failure surfaces through the caller's CATCH.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
